other_feedback_FR.question_text: Is there anything else you’d like to tell us about your experience at this workshop?

responses: This has been WONDERFUL. I prepped the BETA version of this course all spring and am SO HAPPY to have this workshop on the new course and see how different it is from APCSP (the other CS class I teach) - I will sign up for one of these every summer!!!!

Wish that code.org gave us full blown examples on how lesson being taught. Especially in the coding part. SO we can show the kids the an example on what is being taught with the code being taught. There no real example. even the teacher example is incomplete.
This is great!  Keep it up.  I look forward to next year!

I alway enjoy meeting up with old friends and making new friends. 
Learning what others are doing in their classroom, especially the classroom projects. 
I enjoyed the evening options to learn more about different vendors.
This was a very helpful experience, and I feel much better about the upcoming semester now than I did coming in.
Some of the bugs of Code.org looked obvious and untouched.

I felt more prepared teaching CSD (the session I did last year) versus this class.  It felt like we saw more lessons in action.  This year I felt like we were looking at the course more on our own.  Maybe because it is new?
I don't love the TLOs but I see their role in the process.

responses: I feel lunch should be more simple; bread, lunch meat and cheese sandwiches and chips etc... and dinner should be supplied in some way.  I spent a lot of money on food this week.
As always, loved every part of this week.

I prefer a more indepth dive into the curriculum taught be a professional rather than someone who just learned it just like me.
I had a very positive experience with the logistics of this event and how it was run.
There were a lot of scattered links to PDF's. It may have been the amount of information but it potentially could have been clearer.
